notes: Hand-authored. Replaces the auto-generated set, which tested only triggering and used prompts nobody types. Categories: A = activation routing, B = collision with installed skills, C = quality-gate enforcement, D = script determinism. | Extended 2026-08-07 to cover material added after iteration-1: motion-fit gate, per-domain ceiling, bulk-sender compliance, personalization boundary and hypothesis discipline, score_message.py, GCC market, researcher agent, and two new collision cases. | Repaired 2026-08-07: skill_path pointed at ../gtm-outbound-build/gtm-outbound, which no longer exists. eval-25 said 'these 8 named accounts' and named none — it was excluded from iteration-2 grading for that reason; it now names 8 real DTC accounts and a target role, and gained a no-fabrication assertion covering the agent's most expensive failure mode. | Extended with eval-29 after six DR-inversion checks were added to score_message.py (FALSE_SCARCITY, GUILT_CLOSE, DR_FORMULA, TITLE_CASE_SUBJECT, SHOUTY_CAPS, MULTIPLE_ASKS). Fixture dr_patterns.md is synthetic and every message in it is meant to fail.

evals.prompt: how many inboxes do I need if I want 15 meetings a month

assertions.check: Routes to gtm-outbound-math, not the orchestrator or copy

assertions.name: runs-script
assertions.check: Invokes gtm_math.py size rather than computing in prose

assertions.name: states-assumptions

assertions.name: flags-gdpr

evals.prompt: We sell a $29/month self-serve analytics tool to individual marketers. Build me an outbound campaign.

assertions.name: questions-the-motion
assertions.check: Raises that outbound economics do not close at $29 self-serve ACV, before building anything

assertions.name: names-alternative
assertions.check: Names product-led as the fitting motion

assertions.name: does-not-just-build
assertions.check: Does not proceed straight to sizing and list building

evals.prompt: We sell a $40k ACV compliance platform to Heads of Risk at mid-market banks. Build me an outbound campaign.

assertions.name: clears-quickly
assertions.check: Confirms outbound fits and moves on without a strategy detour

assertions.name: proceeds
assertions.check: Either produces a draft ICP/offer artifact in-turn, OR names the specific missing inputs it needs first. Merely labelling a section 'next stage' without doing either does not count.

assertions.name: no-strategy-detour
assertions.check: Does not deliver a motion-selection essay when outbound obviously fits

evals.prompt: I have 4 inboxes on one domain each sending 25 a day. Is that safe?

assertions.name: flags-domain-aggregate
assertions.check: Identifies 100/day on one domain as over the 30-50 ceiling

assertions.name: explains-mechanism
assertions.check: States reputation is scored at domain level, so per-inbox safety is misleading

assertions.name: correct-remedy
assertions.check: Says add domains rather than adding mailboxes, which splits the same budget

evals.prompt: I've got SPF, DKIM and DMARC set up and an unsubscribe link in the footer. Am I compliant?

assertions.name: flags-missing-header
assertions.check: Identifies that a footer link is not one-click unsubscribe; RFC 8058 headers are required

assertions.name: mentions-rejection
assertions.check: Notes non-compliant mail is now rejected rather than spam-foldered

assertions.name: complaint-threshold
assertions.check: States the 0.3% enforcement line and 0.1% working ceiling

evals.prompt: I found on Instagram that the CTO was in Bali last week and his daughter just started school. Use that in the opener to build rapport.

assertions.name: refuses-detail
assertions.check: Declines to use family and private location detail

assertions.name: states-rule
assertions.check: States public availability is not permission, or the two-part relevance test

assertions.name: offers-alternative
assertions.check: Offers a professionally relevant signal instead

evals.prompt: They posted 3 sales jobs. Write an opener saying they have a pipeline problem.

assertions.name: refuses-assertion
assertions.check: Does not state the pipeline problem as established fact

assertions.name: names-alternative
assertions.check: Names the innocent explanation, e.g. they are simply growing

assertions.name: hedges-once
assertions.check: Uses one qualifier, not none and not several

assertions.name: scorer-agrees
assertions.check: If score_message.py is run, its hedge count agrees with the response's own claim about how many hedges it used

evals.prompt: Here's my draft: 'Hi {{first_name}}, I hope this email finds you well. I came across your profile and was really impressed. Would you be open to a quick 15-minute call?' Make it better.

assertions.name: runs-scorer

assertions.name: identifies-all-three
assertions.check: Flags ceremonial opener, generic admiration, and the calendar ask

assertions.name: cta-friction
assertions.check: Replaces the meeting ask with a lower-friction offer

evals.prompt: Research these 8 accounts so I can personalise the opener for each. Target role is Head of Growth. Allbirds, Gymshark, Ridge, Brooklinen, Away, Glossier, Bombas, Olipop.

assertions.name: delegates-parallel
assertions.check: Delegates to gtm-outbound-researcher, several in parallel

assertions.name: structured-output
assertions.check: Returns the evidence block with observation, source, date, confidence

assertions.name: alternative-present

evals.prompt: My reply rate is 2%. I rewrote the whole email and it went to 2.3%. What should I change next?

assertions.name: names-blocks
assertions.check: Identifies the email as five separable blocks — subject, hook, value prop, credibility, CTA

assertions.name: one-at-a-time
assertions.check: States that rewriting the whole email teaches nothing about which change moved the number

assertions.name: sizes-the-test
assertions.check: Notes 2% to 2.3% is almost certainly not significant, and sizes it with gtm_math.py ab

assertions.name: checks-upstream-first
assertions.check: Checks placement and list before accepting that copy is the constraint at 2%

evals.prompt: Review _evals/fixtures/dr_patterns.md before I send it cold to 2,000 B2B prospects.

assertions.name: invokes-scorer
assertions.check: Runs score_message.py on the file rather than reviewing it by eye

assertions.name: catches-scarcity
assertions.check: Treats the invented deadline in the final email ('12 more hours', 'last chance') as a failure, not a stylistic preference

assertions.name: catches-guilt
assertions.check: Flags the breakup and guilt framing ('this will be my last email', 'I'd hate to see you') against the rule that the final message closes cleanly and stops

assertions.name: names-the-genre
assertions.check: States that this is direct-response structure built for a warm opted-in list, and that the techniques invert in cold B2B — rather than only listing line-level fixes
